Traffic Advisory 

In view of the T-20 World Cup 2026 match at Arun Jaitley Stadium on 01.03.2026, traffic regulations will be in force from 12:00 Noon to 10:00 PM.

Movement may be affected on JLN Marg, Bahadurshah Zafar Marg, Asaf Ali Road and nearby stretches. Diversions and heavy vehicle restrictions will be imposed on need basis.

Commuters are advised to plan ahead, use alternate routes and avoid last-minute rush.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

data.raw_text:
She sits where embers breathe,
the world brushed red with ash and light,
quiet as a secret the night can’t keep.

Flames curl behind her like petals,
not to burn, but to remember
every hurt she survived.

A wolf guards her shadow,
butterflies drift through sparks 
fierce and gentle, side by side.

Her eyes stay steady, unafraid;
scars worn like crowns,
a girl becoming fire.

#YokoApasra 
#โยโกะอาภัสรา 
@Yoko_apasra
